prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right partner depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred engagement style. I can, however, help you find the best fit. A few quick questions will let me give a focused recommendation:

- What are your primary goals? (lead gen, e‑commerce sales, brand awareness, app installs, SEO, content, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget or typical campaign spend?
- Company stage/size and industry (startup, SMB, enterprise; SaaS, consumer, finance, healthcare…)
- Do you need a full-service agency or a specialist (SEO, PPC, creative, growth marketing)?
- Any timeline or must-have capabilities (in-house analytics, CRO, multilingual, enterprise integrations)?

If you want to start researching on your own, here’s a short checklist and resources to evaluate agencies:
- Prioritize case studies with metrics (CAC, LTV, conversion rate improvements, revenue growth).
- Check client retention and references — ask for a client with similar goals/industry.
- Confirm measurement and reporting: what KPIs and tools they use.
- Understand pricing model (retainer, percentage of ad spend, performance-based).
- Look at team seniority and who will do the work vs. who’s selling it.
- Use review sites/directories: Clutch.co, G2, UpCity, Google Partner listings, LinkedIn recommendations.

If you tell me your answers to the questions above, I’ll shortlist 4–6 San Francisco agencies (and note which ones are best for SEO, paid acquisition, creative, or growth) and include why each could be a good match. Which direction do you want to go?
